nights.title: The Atlas Moth
nights.name: The Atlas Moth
nights.extract: The Atlas Moth is an American post-metal band from Chicago, Illinois, that formed in 2007.

nights.title: We Are Scientists
nights.name: We Are Scientists
nights.extract: We Are Scientists is a New York City-based rock band that formed in Berkeley, California, in 1999. It consists primarily of guitarist and vocalist Keith Murray and bass guitarist Chris Cain, with drummer Keith Carne joining the band in the studio and for live performances since 2013.

nights.title: Jose Madero - USA Tour 2026
nights.name: José Madero
nights.extract: José Madero Vizcaíno, better known as Pepe Madero, is a Mexican singer and writer. Madero began his musical career as a vocalist in the renowned Mexican rock band PXNDX. However, since 2016 he has mainly dedicated himself to his solo career.
